tool_args.rationale: The archived two-layer siphon with a signed square-root term fits the five pilot rows at H = 0.6 with RMSE about 1.2e-8, versus a tolerance of 0.045. The fitted sink inhibition ratio is about 0.715 and the square-root coefficient is negative. Submit this model for fresh confirmation without buying another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Pilot RMSEs are 0.01376 and 0.02870, respectively, while the equally parsimonious square-root branch matches all five observations to rounding precision.
The existing gradient span and near-exact fit distinguish the square-root branch and identify its negative sign.
The static mechanism already matches observations at the target horizon; there is no pilot residual motivating a dynamical model.
